sections.title: Travel experiences
sections.content:
Rich vocabulary for describing travel:
• itinerary — a planned route or journey. We prepared a detailed itinerary for our two-week trip.
• excursion — a short journey for pleasure. The hotel offers daily excursions to nearby islands.
• trek — a long, difficult walk. They completed a five-day trek through the Himalayas.
• commute — regular travel between home and work. Her daily commute takes about forty minutes by train.
• jet lag — tiredness after crossing time zones. It took three days to recover from the jet lag.

sections.title: Accommodation and logistics
sections.content:
Practical travel vocabulary:
• amenities — useful features of a place. The hotel offers excellent amenities including a pool and gym.
• all-inclusive — a package that covers everything. We booked an all-inclusive resort for a stress-free holiday.
• layover — a stop during a journey. We had a six-hour layover in Dubai airport.
• customs — the place where luggage is checked at borders. We had to declare items at customs upon arrival.
• visa — official permission to enter a country. You need a tourist visa to visit that country.

sections.title: Cultural travel
sections.content:
Words for cultural aspects of travel:
• heritage — traditions and monuments from the past. The city is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• immerse — involve deeply in an activity or culture. She immersed herself in the local culture during her stay.
• cuisine — a style of cooking. Italian cuisine is famous around the world.
• souvenir — an object bought to remember a trip. I bought a small ceramic plate as a souvenir.

exercises.question: A detailed plan of your journey including places and times is an:
exercises.explanation: An itinerary is a planned route or list of places to visit on a journey.

exercises.question: Tiredness caused by travelling across different time zones is:
exercises.explanation: Jet lag is extreme tiredness felt after a long flight across time zones.

exercises.question: A stop between connecting flights is a:
exercises.hint: Waiting at an airport between flights.
exercises.explanation: A layover is a period of rest or waiting during a journey, especially at an airport.

exercises.question: To deeply involve yourself in another culture is to:
exercises.explanation: To immerse means to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

exercises.question: Useful features and services provided at a hotel are:
exercises.explanation: Amenities are desirable features or facilities of a building or place.

exercises.question: Your regular daily journey between home and work is your:
exercises.hint: You do it every working day.
exercises.explanation: A commute is a regular journey between home and place of work.

exercises.question: The historical traditions and monuments of a place are its:
exercises.hint: What has been passed down through history.
exercises.explanation: Heritage refers to valued objects, traditions, and qualities passed down from previous generations.

exercises.question: A style of cooking associated with a particular country or region is:
exercises.explanation: Cuisine is a style of cooking characteristic of a particular country or region.
